caption:
If you expect price to respect one perfect line every time, rethink the chart.

Markets often react around areas rather than one exact price. Repeated reactions can help you mark a zone, but the zone is not a guaranteed floor or ceiling. Watch how price behaves when it returns, consider the higher timeframe, and decide what would invalidate your idea.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
